n_d833331532b39ed0.name: Find new posts
n_d833331532b39ed0.source: export default function plan({posts,includes,pageState}){const records=pageState?.records;if(!Array.isArray(posts)||!Array.isArray(records))throw Error('Invalid search or Airtable response');const users=new Map((includes?.users??[]).map(u=>[String(u.id),u.username])),known=new Set(records.map(r=>r?.fields?.Tweet_id).filter(x=>x!==undefined&&x!==null).map(String)),pending=[];for(const p of posts){if(typeof p.id!=='string'||typeof p.text!=='string'||typeof p.createdAt!=='string'||typeof p.publicMetrics?.like_count!=='number')throw Error('Missing post ID, text, creation time or like count');if(known.has(p.id))continue;const author=users.get(String(p.authorId));if(typeof author!=='string'||!author)throw Error('Missing expanded post author');const replyId=p.raw?.in_reply_to_user_id,reply=replyId==null?null:users.get(String(replyId));if(replyId!=null&&typeof reply!=='string')throw Error('Missing expanded reply user');pending.push({fields:{Likes:p.publicMetrics?.like_count??0,Tweet:p.text,Tweet_id:p.id,'Tweet URL':'https://twitter.com/'+author+'/status/'+p.id,Author:reply,Time:p.createdAt}})}return{pending}}

n_0bac8a93ae9bd8b9.name: Prepare next batch
n_0bac8a93ae9bd8b9.source: export default function next({pending,previousState}){const state=previousState??{index:0};if(previousState)state.index+=10;if(!Array.isArray(pending)||state.index>pending.length+9)throw Error('Invalid write state');return{state,more:state.index<pending.length,records:state.index<pending.length?pending.slice(state.index,state.index+10):[{fields:{}}],count:Math.min(state.index,pending.length)}}
